text.p: Italian bond futures lower ahead of the data from the first six Italian cities reporting preliminary April CPI later at 1530 GMT, when CPI inflation is expected to dip under two percent, dealers said.
Other European bond markets also lower with German bunds showing technical weakness and French bonds off on fears of a call for snap elections, dealers said.

They added that there were also reports over the weekend of an IMF report critical of Italy's 1997 mini-budget because it did not address structural problems. Lira and dollar also lower and contributing to BTP weakness.
